hemisphere.readerPolicy: Use a study-scoped, publisher-declared right-hemisphere context and side-neutral selector names. Expose the original lookup-table names and their inconsistency. Do not grant per-requirement side or extent approval from this policy.

signal.upstreamAcquisition: FLASH as described by Edlow et al. (2019)

segmentationMethod.publicationDescription: Sparse manual tracing, interpolation and manual correction; cortical subdivision uses FreeSurfer.

extentPolicy: Treat each original categorical label as its source-defined region. Broad names do not establish a complete parent structure after subregions have separate labels. No missing region, contralateral anatomy or unlabelled tissue is inferred.
prohibitedCoverageInferences: Raw Left/L_ LUT prefixes must not create left-sided reporting bindings for this publisher-described right-hemisphere reference.
No full parent extent may be inferred from a broad categorical name alone.
Codes 99, 100 and 101 have no source voxels and must remain unavailable.
Fibre-region masks do not establish tract trajectories or functional connectivity.
The supplied 0.2-mm grid and UInt8 signal do not establish acquisition resolution or quantitative T2.
